name: io.github.sbanthia92/fpl-context-mcp
title: FPL Context
description: Live Fantasy Premier League data for AI agents with zero setup, plus optional SQL over your own stats database.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Read-only PostgreSQL DSN for your FPL stats database (populate it with fpl-context-ingest-match). Without it the live tools work and query_historical_stats is not offered.
